Supporters of Imran Khan and his family members were enraged earlier this
month after hearing that the former Pakistani prime minister and political
prisoner had lost [85% of vision](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-
pacific/pakistans-jailed-imran-khan-loses-85-vision-right-eye-lawyer-
says-2026-02-13/) in his right eye. Now in a battle to secure the care he
needs, his sister **Aleema Khan** is set to join a **Zeteo** town hall to
discuss the latest in her fight for her brother's health and freedom.
